g.text: Prediction | A machine ID to a checked, attributable score
Layer 2 · Request and response steps. Lookup/check steps execute inside the Feature API process.
The machine request passes the gateway; clients do not call KServe directly.
Three clocks: native event age | Redis key expiry | one-hour real preparation lease
Serving preparation populates its own state/project; the four stream aggregates are not model inputs.
Scores describe simulated equipment and are not calibrated real-world failure probabilities.
